Q2 revenue7099 versus6843, company-reported growth4%, constant currency2%; global comparable sales1.3% versus3.8% prior-year quarter. US comparable sales0.8% with negative guest counts and higher average check/product mix; IOM1.5%, IDL1.9%, with negative comps in France and China respectively. Q2 GAAP/adjusted non-GAAP operating income3338/3391, calculated margins47.0%/47.8%; previous-year3232/3275, margins47.2%/47.9%. GAAP/adjusted net income2362/2402 versus2253/2286; diluted EPS3.32/3.38 versus3.14/3.19. Company reports EPS growth6% on both bases. Rounded pre-tax adjustments52 and after-tax40 primarily concern Accelerating the Organization;3338+52 differs by1 from reported adjusted operating income3391 due to source rounding; do not force reconciliation. Table derived income growth: adjusted operating3.5%, GAAP net4.8%, adjusted net5.1%. Q2 operating cash flow2807, capex831, derived FCF1976=2807-831; prior-yearOCF1998, capex744, FCF1254; FCF growth57.6%. H1 OCF5222, capex1516, FCF3706; do not label H1 cash flow as quarterly. Full10-Q segment revenue including allocated Other: US2827,IOM3603,IDL&Corporate669=sum7099. Supplement segment amounts2726/3543/648 exclude182 other and must not replace these totals. Revenue categories franchised4393,company-operated2525,other182 sum7100 versus official7099 because of rounding. Roughly95% of restaurants franchised,46028 restaurants atJun30. Q2 systemwide sales about37bn,reported growth5%/CC4%, not consolidated revenue.70 loyalty markets,TTM loyalty systemwide sales40bn,nearly220m90-day active users; neither loyalty nor total systemwide sales should be added to consolidated company revenue. August4 FY2026 company outlook: capex3.7–3.9bn,operating margin mid-to-high40% range,about2600 gross openings/2100 net additions,FCF conversion low-to-mid80% range. September23 NEXT targets by2030: corporate operating margin low-to-mid50% range,SG&A/systemwide sales about1.9%,FCF conversion mid-to-high80% range. Gross restaurant-level efficiency250bps in US and IOM upon full deployment, not a guaranteed corporate margin uplift.2027–2030 baseline capex about3bn annually PLUS cumulative1.5–2.0bn additional capital partnering support, not annual additional support. Targets are forward-looking, not realized results. No original broker investment theses supplied; never invent them. Q3 2026 EEO market estimates: revenue7.291bn,EPS Adj+3.403,EPS GAAP3.402; not company guidance. EEO next4 Price/EPS Adj+:QSR16.47,MCD17.89,YUM21.48,SBUX31.30. Displayed next4 quarter ends2026/09/30,2026/12/31,2027/03/31,2027/06/30, but Starbucks fiscal labels differ. MCD,QSR,SBUX quotes show08-Oct, YUMdate cropped; no independent EEO asof date established, do not claim verified same-date closing prices. Definitions and business models differ despite common Adj+ label. Do not sum independently sampled quarterly rows into an annual consensus. YUM is Yum! Brands, not separately listed Yum China/YUMC. Use names matching the requested locale and page chart.
